dashboard.label: TA-amdgpu Overview
dashboard.description: Collects AMD GPU telemetry from /sys/class/drm/cardN/device (VRAM used/total, busy %, temperature via associated hwmon) and /sys/class/kfd (GPU count, memory info) when AMD GPUs

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-amdgpu" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-amdgpu. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-amdgpu requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-amdgpu", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-amdgpu/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("amdgpu.gpu_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("amdgpu.kfd") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="amdgpu:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"vram_used_mib\":\s*(?<v>[0-9]+)" | mvexpand v | stats sum(v) as value
index=main sourcetype="amdgpu:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"temperature_c\":\s*(?<t>[0-9.]+)" | mvexpand t | stats max(t) as value

index=main sourcetype="amdgpu:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"busy_pct\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | spath input=o path=busy_pct | spath input=o path=vram_used_mib | spath input=o path=vram_total_mib | spath input=o path=temperature_c | table host k busy_pct vram_used_mib vram_total_mib temperature_c
